name: Orator
description: Script-first presentation authoring: write what you'll say, gather what they'll see.

APP_SECRET.description: Encrypts users' Anthropic API keys at rest. Never change it once users have saved keys (they'd become unreadable).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID (Google Cloud Console → Credentials).

APPLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Sign in with Apple Services ID, e.g. com.orator-ai.web.

APPLE_KEY_ID.description: Key ID of the Sign in with Apple private key.

APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Contents of the .p8 private key file.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Canonical origin, e.g. https://www.orator-ai.com. Sign-in callback URLs are built from it.

ANTHROPIC_KEY_OWNER_EMAIL.description: Account that receives ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on sign-in (one-time handover).

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional; only used for the one-time handover above. Remove once handed over.
